rationale: Third, independent scenario for unit-C-append-log-identity-consistency, testing the vote-facing consequence the claim's unknowns leave open. After the accepted truncation-then-StoreLogs-failure premise the node's real log ends at index 1 term 1 while its cached last entry still reads index 3 term 2, so a RequestVote at the next term whose candidate log ends at index 2 term 2 is strictly more up to date than the real log and must be granted; the vote handler's up-to-date comparison reads the cached identity and is expected to refuse. The oracle is the handler's own Granted field. Construction in a scratch copy of the captured source showed the vote refused with cached_index 3 against real_index 1; that local run is construction knowledge only and formal evidence requires the trusted runner's clean-copy execution, which is requested here.
